messages.text: 'Lack of talent' - Alonso doubles down on Albon criticism

metadata.summary: Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso has doubled down on his criticism of "low level" Formula 1 drivers who have a "lack of talent" following his collision with Williams' Alex Albon in Austin.
metadata.content: Fernando Alonso doubles down on Alex Albon and F1 field criticism ahead of Mexico City Grand Prix | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Fernando Alonso doubles down on Alex Albon and F1 field criticism ahead of Mexico City Grand Prix Two-time F1 world champion Fernando Alonso has reiterated his criticism of Williams' Alex Albon and other drivers who battle at the back of the grid in F1; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 29 October 2026 21:13, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso was scathing in his assessment of the talent level of the lower third of the Formula 1 grid Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso has doubled down on his criticism of "low level" Formula 1 drivers who have a "lack of talent" following his collision with Williams' Alex Albon in Austin. Albon tried to overtake Alonso for 12th place into the Turn 11 hairpin on the opening lap of the United States Grand Prix, but went into the side of the Aston Martin driver, damaging both cars. Neither driver received a penalty and both were able to continue with Alonso finishing 16th and Albon in 17th in Austin. messages.text: Grealish dropped by Everton after breaching club discipline

metadata.summary: Everton said Jack Grealish was unavailable for their Carabao Cup fourth-round tie against Newcastle 'due to a breach of club discipline'.
metadata.content: Jack Grealish dropped by Everton after breaching club discipline ahead of Newcastle Carabao Cup tie | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Jack Grealish dropped by Everton after breaching club discipline ahead of Newcastle Carabao Cup tie Jack Grealish was dropped by Everton boss David Moyes for their game against Newcastle in the Carabao Cup fourth round; Everton said the midfielder was 'unavailable for selection due to a breach of club discipline' Thursday 29 October 2026 22:12, UK Image: Jack Grealish was dropped by Everton after breaching club discipline Everton said Jack Grealish was unavailable for their Carabao Cup fourth-round tie against Newcastle 'due to a breach of club discipline'. Grealish, who is on loan from Manchester City, missed Saturday's defeat at Arsenal due to illness but had started Everton's previous three Premier League matches against Ipswich, Hull City and Chelsea. He was dropped by manager David Moyes for their cup tie at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Thursday night after reportedly missing a training session. Transfer Centre LIVE! | Latest on YOUR PL club! messages.text: Antonelli misses Mexico media day with viral illness

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli missed Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion.
metadata.content: Kimi Antonelli misses Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Kimi Antonelli misses Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is recovering from a viral illness ahead of the weekend where he is expected to secure the Drivers' Championship; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Thursday 29 October 2026 22:21, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player On The F1 Show podcast, Ant Davidson explains how Kimi Antonelli stays grounded as he closes in on a world title Kimi Antonelli missed Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion. A top-nine finish in this Sunday's race will ensure Antonelli becomes the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old - breaking Sebastian Vettel's record by three years. Should Antonelli not score any points on Sunday, he will still be world champion if his Mercedes team-mate George Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton don't win the race. messages.text: McCullum: Brook one of best tactical captains I've come across

metadata.summary: Brendon McCullum called Harry Brook "one of the best tactical captains I've ever come across" after England ended a tough ODI tri-series with a consolation win over Sri Lanka in Lahore.
metadata.content: England head coach Brendon McCullum hails captain Harry Brook after tourists end ODI tri-series with consolation win | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England head coach Brendon McCullum hails captain Harry Brook after tourists end ODI tri-series with consolation win England boss Brendon McCullum talks Harry Brook's leadership, Adil Rashid's omission and the lessons learned as tourists earn victory at last in ODI tri-series; after missing out on the final, McCullum's men now focused on white-ball tour of Australia in November (three ODIs, five T20s) Thursday 29 October 2026 18:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player England head coach Brendon McCullum opens up on his side's performances throughout the ODI tri-series as they failed to make the final Brendon McCullum called Harry Brook "one of the best tactical captains I've ever come across" after England ended a tough ODI tri-series with a consolation win over Sri Lanka in Lahore. England lost their first three matches after a botched run chase against Pakistan was followed by failing to defend a total of 429 against Sri Lanka and then suffering another defeat to Pakistan as the hosts reached a target of 242 despite having been 154-9. Brook's side looked in danger of a fourth loss from four when Pavan Rathnayake scored his second hundred against England in as many matches on Thursday but they eventually bowled Sri Lanka out for 331 as their opponents pursued a target of 387.
